data_labels.name: a7_timer_callback_slots
data_labels.comment: 12 records stride0x10: state/free(-1), callback, reload, countdown. Shared timer for slots3..11.

data_labels.name: a7_startup_cached_callback
data_labels.comment: Copy of service object+0x2c; independent of callback eligibility/status.

data_labels.name: a7_component_status
data_labels.comment: Six component flags reached0x3f in prior trace; bit1 also gates callback dispatcher60049bcc.

data_labels.name: a7_startup_service_object_ptr
data_labels.comment: Pointer to service object; trace value6232d9ec. Callback slot at+0x2c.

data_labels.name: a7_startup_service_callback_slot
data_labels.comment: Observed service object+0x2c; prior component loader registered60400000. Do not infer execution from pointer alone.

data_labels.name: a7_m4_shared_boot_permission
data_labels.comment: M4 GPIOB7-derived shared gate read by6001d47c; physical pin default unresolved.

data_labels.name: a7_m4_ipc_shared_slots
data_labels.comment: 72-byte IPC slot transport at2f028000; request ID/response for slot0 at+0xc.

data_labels.name: a7_m4_ipc_slot0_service_or_response
data_labels.comment: Same word carries service1808 request then M4 result; transport status is separate.
